subject: USAGE DISPLAY (size and representation of characters)
notes: A.1 item 209 is USAGE DISPLAY (§13.18.60.4 GR7); the row carried the USAGE BIT determination (GR5 + §8.5.1.6.3) under its number until 2026-09-03, when it was re-filed and the BIT determination moved to §3 (A.1 has no USAGE BIT item at all - 208 COMPUTATIONAL runs straight to 209 DISPLAY). All three GR7 obligations are measured, not asserted: uniform size (UNI=1 5 9 over X(1)/X(5)/X(9)), the constraint against the national size (LEQN=1 2), the character-boundary alignment that generates no filler (ALIGN=5), the position/byte identity (POS=5 5), and the numeric-DISPLAY sign grid (NUM=5 5 6). retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/Model/PicInfo.cs#ByteWidth (ByteWidth is a member of DataItem (Binding/Model/DataItem.cs); PicInfo.cs names it only in comments)
